Mason (People Ops): Short update: attestation window closing soon. This is a heads-up about an escalation path if teams miss the deadline. Read the quick steps and reply when done.

Ellen (Security): TL;DR: teams with >5 unlabeled high-risk artifacts after the deadline will be escalated to their managers and may face temporary write restrictions to affected buckets/repos until evidence is attached. We will not block deploys lightly; only if scanner marks items as HIGH and no owner responds.

Mason (People Ops): Steps (quick): 1) finish the 8-min annual attestation form; 2) upload docs to Evidence Vault or tag assets `evidence:attached`; 3) confirm in-thread `team-name: done`. Deadline: 48 hours from now (EOD PT). Link: https://redwood-internal.company/attest/annual-quick

Raj (Legal): Reminder: contractors must have signed DPA + attestation. Managers 9please post `team: contractor1, contractor2` here if unsure. Well follow up on missing DPAs.

Tom (Eng): Quick Q: If an asset is sample data in an internal demo bucket, is tagging enough or do we need to scrub?

Ellen (Security): If sample data contains no real identifiers mark `note:synthetic` in Evidence Vault. If theres any real identifiers, scrub + re-upload encrypted copy and tag `evidence:attached`.

Priya (Manager): My team is in the middle of a release window. If we get escalated, how long are write locks?

Ellen (Security): Typical lock is 48 hours while owners remediate. We notify managers 24 hours before lock if items remain unresolved. If you need an exception for an active release, DM me with the release window and well exempt specific prefixes.

Mason (People Ops): Office hours to help with attestations and tagging: Wed 1-2pm PT and Thu 8-9am PT in #compliance-help. Zoom: https://zoom.company/compliance. If you cant make office hours open a ticket at https://redwood-internal.company/it-requests with subject "attestation-help".

Ellen (Security): Quick helper for git repos:```bash
# add evidence note to repo
echo "evidence:attached" >> scrub_status.md
git add scrub_status.md && git commit -m "evidence: attach" && git push
```

ComplianceBot: Reminder scheduled: 24 hours left, 6 hours left, and final-hour ping. :bell:

Mason (People Ops): Managers please reply with confirmations. If you post `team-name: done` well mark your team green in the dashboard.

Priya (Manager): Data Tools: done. Will upload two artifacts tonight and confirm once in Evidence Vault.

Tom (Eng): Platform: running the quick scan now, will tag repos by EOD.

Mason (People Ops): Thanks all. Well post a final summary after the deadline and ping managers for any escalations. If you have special circumstances (timezone/leave), request an extension via the ticket link above.
